items.title: Palm Oil Cargo Operations: Getting the Cargo Details Right
points: Palm oil and its derivatives may not be classified as hazardous cargoes but carrying them successfully is not always straightforward.

If the cargo is allowed to cool too much, it may begin to solidify and become difficult to pump.

Tanks, lines and pumps should therefore be clean, dry and carefully inspected before loading, while heating coils should be pressure-tested and any cleaning chemicals fully removed from the cargo system.

items.title: Wärtsilä Converts Engines On 3 Chevron LNG Carriers To Reduce Methane Emissions On Vessels
points: Technology group Wärtsilä has successfully completed the conversion of one engine on three LNG carriers operated by Chevron Transport Corporation from dual-fuel (DF) to spark gas (SG) operation.
This conversion aims to lower greenhouse gas emissions from the vessels by reducing methane slip, combusted methane that can escape into the atmosphere from LNG fuel.
This project represents a technical collaboration within the marine sector focused on addressing methane emissions from LNG-fueled vessels.
Wärtsilä’s 50DF to spark gas conversion project will modify the engines in service to operate as spark gas, using spark ignition versus diesel pilot fuel to initiate combustion.
The Spark Gas Conversion for the Wärtsilä 50DF engine minimises methane emissions by introducing an electrically controlled pre-combustion chamber valve.
The estimated result is that, on an IMO weighted (E2-cycle) average, the conversion reduces methane emissions to 1.1 percent of fuel use.
The solution is available to vessels in the industry with existing Wärtsilä 50DF engines for diesel-electric propulsion, the majority of which are LNG carriers.

points: Iran has exempted merchant vessels from India, China, Iraq and Qatar from restrictions on using the Strait of Hormuz, and the measure is aimed at facilitating the procurement of medicines from India, an influential Iranian lawmaker has said.
Ships from these countries pass freely, and the Americans do not intercept them either,” Hayat-Moghaddam said in an interview with the Iranian Students' News Agency on Tuesday.

The accused, Gokul, who resides near the Thiruvalla railway station, allegedly drove the rented Toyota Innova at high speed for nearly eight km, causing a series of accidents on Tuesday evening.
Police said the youth, who had hired the car from Thiruvalla, was suspected to be under the influence of alcohol or narcotic drugs, though this was yet to be ascertained.
The car was proceeding towards Changanassery when it first hit a scooter ridden by Nanditha (21) at Mundukotta in Paippad.
She was returning home after work at a private hospital in Thiruvalla.
However, the driver did not stop and continued speeding through Thrikodithanam towards Thengana.
More than a dozen vehicles were reportedly damaged in the series of accidents.

items.title: Body of third trekker missing in Uttarakhand found; toll rises to 3

“The search and rescue teams recovered two bodies on Tuesday and another body on Wednesday.
The search for the remaining missing trekkers is underway,” State Disaster Response Force (SDRF) commandant Arpan Yaduvanshi said.
The missing group consisted of five male trekkers from West Bengal, two female trekkers from Uttar Pradesh, and a local guide from Uttarkashi.
“The bodies were brought to Matli helipad in Uttarkashi via helicopter at 11:52am.
The avalanche struck near Kedar Kharak on October 29 as the expedition was descending from Kedartal, a glacial lake situated at an elevation of 15,485 feet (4,720 metres).
The 12-member expedition, comprising seven trekkers and five support personnel, flagged off from Gangotri on October 27 and was slated to complete the circuit by October 29.

The limited production run motorcycles draw inspiration from that custom but retain more of the standard Shotgun 650’s silhouette.
Power comes from Royal Enfield’s established 650 Twin engine.
Every one of the 100 production motorcycles will be offered with a limited Royal Enfield x Deus stone-washed sateen souvenir jacket.

items.title: Police detain rail roko protesters demanding CEC Gyanesh Kumar's arrest in Tamil Nadu
points: Tension prevailed near the old railway station in Kanchipuram on Wednesday after members of the Jananayaka Meetpu Kuzhu staged a rail roko protest demanding the arrest of Chief Election Commissioner (CEC) Gyanesh Kumar.
The protesters alleged that the CEC acted in favour of Prime Minister Narendra Modi by disqualifying 13 crore voters.
Heavy police and Railway Protection Force personnel were deployed in the area in view of the demonstration.

More than 350 protesters marched in a rally from near Hotel Tamil Nadu towards the East Railway Station, where a scuffle broke out between the demonstrators and the police when officers attempted to stop their advance.

Defying police barricades, more than 50 protesters sat on the railway tracks and raised slogans against the Prime Minister and the Election Commission, repeating their demand for the arrest of the CEC.
Members of Makkal Mandram, Communist Party of India, Viduthalai Chiruthaigal Katchi, and independent social activists participated in the agitation which caused tension in the area for about an hour.

items.title: Diwali stock picks, Samvat 2083: Park Medi, HDFC, Paytm, Meesho, Ather among Ventura picks- Which offers highest upside?
points: Diwali Picks, Samvat 2083: With Diwali just around the corner, stock market investors can’t keep calm ahead of the beginning of new Samvat year.
The BSE Sensex and Nifty 50 remained volatile, but traded in the green on Wednesday, November 4, extending their gains after rising for four consecutive sessions.
With less than a week left before the beginning of Samvat 2083, Ventura has unveiled its Diwali stock picks, indicating nearly 83% in some of the stocks.
Park Medi World Limited, HDFC Bank Limited, One97 Communications Limited (Paytm), Meesho Limited, LG Electronics India Limited, and Ather Energy are among top Diwali picks by the brokerage firm.
With its 53% year to date rally, Park Medi World Limited has emerged as one of the most successful IPOs of the last Samvat.
However, the best is not over yet, as Ventura, sees 83.7% upside potential in the stock.

items.title: Maharashtra SIR: 97.16% of voters flagged for anomalies, non-mapping complete verification
points: As many as 97.16% of the 12.22 million voters flagged for anomalies and non-mapping after the enumeration phase of the Special Intensive Revision (SIR) have completed their verification in Maharashtra.
The Election Commission of India (ECI) has received 2.17 million applications for the addition and deletion of names and correction of voter details during the exercise.
The poll body had flagged 12.22 million electors out of the 77.2 million who remained on the draft roll following the enumeration phase, which concluded on August 31.
While 97.94% of the 6.25 million electors flagged for logical discrepancies have cleared their verifications, 96.35% of the 5.98 million unmapped electors have completed the process.

“We expect the remaining 3% of electors to come forward and submit the required documents.” The number of applications received under Forms 6, 7 and 8 for the addition and deletion of names and correction of existing voter details has also increased.

items.title: Warren Buffett has lived through 16 US Presidents. Why he ignores election impact on markets
points: Warren Buffett believes investors should not let political uncertainty or election outcomes dictate their market decisions.

Speaking at Berkshire Hathaway’s 2018 shareholder meeting, he recalled living through multiple US presidencies, split almost equally between Republicans and Democrats, while witnessing major political and economic crises.

items.title: RE Flying Flea S6 Electric Scrambler Revealed, Launch Set For Next Year
points: GaadiWaadi - The Flying Flea S6 builds on the C6’s architecture and features an off-road mode, Fleaware.OS, a round touchscreen and scrambler-based equipment Royal Enfield’s Flying Flea has revealed the S6 electric scrambler ahead of its planned launch…
The motorcycle uses the lightweight architecture developed for the C6 but gets equipment better suited to broken roads, dirt sections and recreational trail riding.
Dart Yellow and Lightning Grey will be the two colour choices available.
It comes with a large wire-spoke front wheel, smaller wire-spoke rear wheel and block-pattern tyres.
Gold-finished upside-down front forks sit beneath a high-mounted yellow mudguard and the long enduro-style seat runs nearly flat towards the tail.
The blue frame stays exposed around the central battery and motor assembly with much of the structure visible.
The centre section uses a large black battery enclosure featuring horizontal ribbing.
The electric motor sits low in the chassis and chain final drive is visible at the rear.

points: Camlin Fine Sciences said elevated raw material prices continue to impact the company's profitability.

items.title: Small-cap apparel stock jumps over 3% after the announcement of Q2 Results 2026 | Do you own?
points: Small-cap stock Vishal Fabrics rose as much as 4% in Wednesday's trading session after the company reported strong set of numbers during the July-September quarter for FY27.
Vishal Fabrics share price opened at ₹16.15 apiece on NSE today, as compared to previous close of ₹16.26 on Tuesday and touched an intraday high of ₹16.90 on 4 November.
The company reported a 21% year-on-year (YoY) increase in profit after tax (PAT) to ₹10.6 crore in Q2 FY27, compared with ₹8.8 crore in Q2 FY26.
Vishal Fabrics share price has gained momentum in the near term, with the stock rising 4.58% over the past week and 5.63% in the last two weeks.
However, the textile stock has remained under pressure over the past month, declining 2.76%.
The stock has also shed 38.55% over the past year, reflecting sustained weakness in its market performance.
Extending the trend, Vishal Fabrics shares have fallen 43.76% over the past two years and 21.80% over three years.

items.title: ABD posts record monthly sales in festive season, adds two millionaire brands
points: Allied Blenders and Distillers reported its highest-ever monthly sales volumes in September and October 2026, with two brands crossing the one-million-case threshold.

Allied Blenders and Distillers Limited (ABD) reported its highest-ever monthly sales volumes in two consecutive months, with sales exceeding 3.5 million cases in September 2026 and crossing 3.6 million cases in October 2026.
Combined volumes for the two months surpassed 7 million cases.
The company’s stock traded at ₹696.25 on Wednesday, up 0.24 per cent intraday, with a market capitalisation of approximately ₹19,475 crore.
The festival season performance marks the fourth time in seven months this financial year that ABD has set a new monthly sales record.
Officer’s Choice Brandy joined ABD’s millionaire brands club on the back of near double-digit market share in key southern states within the Mass Premium category.
Sumo Whisky, the company’s newer Mass Premium offering, also achieved millionaire brand status in October 2026, driven by consumer demand in southern markets.
The scrip’s 52-week high stands at ₹766.90, hit on October 15, 2026.

items.title: US Midterm Election Results: Gold price falls 22% from peak before Dhanteras; should you buy after setback to Trump?
points: Gold price outlook: Victory by Democrats in the US midterm elections have added a fresh dimension to the gold price outlook, with the precious metal rising around 2% on Wednesday as the US dollar weakened.

Democrats scored a sweeping victory in the US midterm elections on Tuesday (November 3, 2026), winning control of both the House of Representatives and the Senate and dealing a major blow to President Donald Trump and his Republican Party.

The election developments come at a time when domestic gold prices remain more than 22% below their 2026 peak, following a sharp correction driven by rising crude oil prices, inflation concerns and expectations of higher US interest rates.
On the Multi Commodity Exchange (MCX), December gold futures were quoted at ₹1,42,471 per 10 grams, up around 2%.
Internationally, spot gold climbed 2.2% to $4,016.01 per ounce, while US gold futures for December delivery rose 2.2% to $4,026.90.

items.title: Meta raises $15 billion through bond sale to fund AI infrastructure expansion
points: Meta Platforms is raising $15 billion through a five-part bond offering to fund its expanding artificial intelligence infrastructure investments.
The fundraising highlights the growing reliance of major technology companies on debt and equity markets to finance the global AI race.

items.title: Oppo Find X10 Ultra Tipped to Feature Dimensity 9600 Pro Chip, 8,000mAh Battery
points: The Oppo Find X10 Ultra has been the subject of the rumour mill for quite a while now.
But it's only recently that leaks have begun surfacing rapidly, and this is perhaps due to the Find X10 and Find X10 Pro Max debuting in global markets.
A tipster has now shed light on the key specifications of the Ultra model.
The purported handset could use MediaTek's next-generation Dimensity processor.
It is also said to feature a high-resolution display, an advanced periscope camera system, and a large battery.

items.title: Delhi HC declines plea seeking removal of objectionable scenes from Sunny Deol film
points: The Delhi high court on Wednesday declined to entertain a petition seeking the removal of allegedly objectionable scenes and dialogues from Sunny Deol-starrer Suryaa: Ant Se Aarambh Takk.

A bench of acting chief justice Nitin Sambre and justice Sanjay Sharma observed that a similar petition had already been filed on behalf of the medical fraternity and was pending consideration before a single-judge bench.
The court, therefore, said there was no justification for initiating parallel proceedings on the same issue.
To be sure, justice Amit Mahajan on Monday had issued notice in a petition filed by four doctors seeking removal of the movie’s teaser and fixed November 16 as the next date of hearing.
This came after the Centre’s counsel, Nishant Gautam, apprised the court of the pending petition and informed it that the process of granting certification to the film was still underway.

In his petition, Bhatia contended that the film’s official teaser features dialogues alleging financial exploitation of patients through excessive billing, unnecessary diagnostic tests and commission-driven prescriptions.

items.title: India’s IPO boom faces a reality check as investors no longer buy every story
points: As many as 124 companies have valid Securities and Exchange Board of India (Sebi) approvals to launch initial public offerings (IPOs), seeking to collectively raise ₹2.45 trillion, according to Prime Database.

Meanwhile, as many as 78 Indian companies raised a record ₹94,205 crore through mainboard IPOs in H1FY27, 35% more than the previous high of ₹69,533 crore raised by 65 IPOs in the same period last year, according to Prime Database.

Amit Ramchandani, managing director and chief executive at Motilal Oswal Investment Advisors, pointed out that while the pipeline for the rest of FY27 remains healthy, market conditions have become more challenging, with investors adopting a more measured…
ESDS Software Solution, which listed in September, surged 111.75%, while Meesho made a strong debut in December 2025, jumping 53.23%.
LG Electronics, too, clocked listing gains of around 48% after its debut on 14 October last year, showed data from ACE Equity.
In contrast, SBI Funds Management's IPO delivered a relatively modest listing gain of 6.2% in July.

items.title: SBI shares edge higher as analysts weigh Q2 beat against opex concerns
points: Traded volume crossed 97.92 lakh shares worth ₹957 crore, reflecting active interest following last week’s Q2FY27 earnings release.
CLSA retained its Outperform rating with a target of ₹1,325, citing a 2 per cent NII beat driven by an 11-basis-point QoQ domestic NIM expansion.
Citi maintained Buy at ₹1,300, highlighting resilient margins and clean asset quality.
Axis Direct and Motilal Oswal both kept Buy ratings with targets of ₹1,275 and ₹1,225, respectively.
Macquarie set an Outperform target at ₹1,220, while HSBC reiterated Buy at ₹1,220.
Kotak Institutional Equities maintained Buy at ₹1,250.

Bernstein was cautious at Market Perform with ₹1,300, noting that excluding one-offs, EPS grew only 5 per cent YoY against the reported 13 per cent, with RoA at 0.90 per cent versus the reported 1.19 per cent.
Q2 PAT was ₹230.4 billion, up 14.3 per cent YoY, boosted by a ₹72.9 billion one-time gain from the SBI Funds stake sale, partly offset by ₹12.8 billion in treasury losses.

items.title: Glittering Prospects: Why Gold is the ultimate sweet spot this Dhanteras
points: Gold is trading over 20% below its peak ahead of Dhanteras, offering long-term investors a potential staggered buying opportunity.
Central-bank demand, ETF inflows and rupee weakness could support prices, with analysts projecting returns of 15–20% by next Dhanteras.

items.title: VinFast VF MPV 7 Gets Massive Rs 4.10 Lakh Price Cut!
points: VinFast has reduced the ex-showroom price of its seven-seat VF MPV 7 from Rs 24.49 lakh to Rs 20.39 lakh, making it Rs 4.10 lakh cheaper.
The revised price is listed on the company's official India website, while dealers are also promoting a separate festive benefit of Rs 40,780, subject to conditions.
The earlier ex-showroom price of Rs 24,49,000 has come down to Rs 20,39,000.
Some VinFast advertising mentions an additional festive benefit of Rs 40,780, which would increase the potential savings for an eligible customer.
The Kia's electric range starts at around Rs 18 lakh and extends to about Rs 25 lakh, depending on battery and variant.
At its former Rs 24.49 lakh price, the VinFast sat close to the most expensive Clavis EV.
At Rs 20.39 lakh, it moves into a more competitive price bracket while retaining its larger battery.
The BYD eMax 7 is another seven-seat electric alternative, with prices previously listed from Rs 26.90 lakh.

items.title: 450 RC Headlines KTM’s Showcase At EICMA 2026, Updated 2027 Models Debut Too
points: The KTM 450 RC stands apart as the key supersport inclusion and is scheduled for production in late 2027.
The 2028 KTM 450 RC uses a twin-cylinder engine but KTM has not released final output figures yet.
A 43 mm adjustable WP Apex USD fork handles the front suspension while a WP Apex shock sits at the rear beside a single-sided swingarm.
Pirelli Diablo Rosso 4 tyres, Cornering ABS, Motorcycle Traction Control, Road and Supermoto ABS modes, selectable ride modes and a 5-inch TFT are also confirmed.
KTM also previewed its next SX-F generation via the 450 SX-F Factory Edition and 250 SX-F Factory Edition.
On the other hand, the KTM 1390 Super Duke R and R Evo receive an 8.8-inch touchscreen TFT, revised handlebar controls, Brembo HyPure front calipers and new colour choices for 2027.
The 390 Adventure X is also due for revisions in India following EICMA debut as it comprises a TFT instrument display and two new colour choices.

items.title: Italjet India Debut Confirmed For IBW 2026, 3 Dragsters Planned
points: Customer deliveries are scheduled to begin in the second quarter of 2027 and the official India waitlist will open in December.
All three models will be assembled at the Motohaus manufacturing facility in Kolhapur, Maharashtra.
Motohaus will handle local assembly and related quality processes at the plant based on Italjet engineering and design developed in Italy.
The Dragster 700 sits at the top of the India-bound range and it uses a 698 cc liquid-cooled parallel-twin kicking out 68 hp at 8,000 rpm and 67 Nm at 5,500 rpm.
Its 278 cc liquid-cooled single-cylinder engine produces 23.8 hp at 8,250 rpm and 26 Nm at 6,250 rpm – paired to a CVT and dry centrifugal automatic clutch.
Its 449 cc liquid-cooled DOHC parallel-twin makes 46.9 hp at 9,500 rpm and 41 Nm at 8,000 rpm.
Indian visitors and media are getting an early look at the three models at EICMA 2026 in Milan ahead of their domestic unveiling.

items.title: Petronet LNG’s inventory boost is not enough to sustain earnings growth
points: Petronet LNG’s September quarter (Q2FY27) results were decent despite supply disruptions amid the West Asia war.
Ebitda surged 49% year-on-year (y-o-y) to ₹1,663 crore (excluding one-offs), beating consensus estimates by 10%, driven by better-than-expected volumes and a favourable mix of higher spot LNG sales.
Antique Stock Broking notes that core Ebitda, excluding these gains, fell 8% y-o-y to ₹1,130 crore.
Total gas volumes processed rose 12% sequentially to 231 trillion British thermal units (TBtu), although y-o-y growth remained modest at 1.3%.
Petronet’s Dahej terminal capacity utilization rose to 94% in Q2FY27 from 84% in Q1FY27 (excluding the capacity commissioned in Q4FY26) and 92% in Q2FY26.
However, the Kochi terminal continues to operate at suboptimal capacity of 23%, primarily due to significant delays in commissioning the Kochi-Bengaluru gas pipeline.
In the last two trading sessions, the Petronet stock rose 3%.
Its CYTD returns stand at 9%, and it trades at 12 times FY27 estimated earnings, according to Bloomberg data.

items.title: Euro-Spec TVS X Unveiled With 140 Km Range & 10.2-Inch Touchscreen
points: GaadiWaadi - The production-ready TVS X gets 15.7 hp peak output, 110 km/h top speed, 140 km claimed range and a 10.2-inch panoramic touchscreen TVS Motor has revealed the European-spec TVS X at EICMA 2026 and it has returned to Milan in final production…
The chassis mounted PMSM develops 15.7 hp at peak and 10.1 hp on a continuous basis in the premium offering.
The TVS X accelerates from 0 to 40 kmph in 2.5 seconds and can top out 110 kmph.
The cockpit uses a 10.2-inch panoramic TFT touchscreen unit with Android Auto connectivity, onboard map navigation, Wi-Fi, Bluetooth and onboard LTE for Europe.
Cruise control is also part of the features list and energy comes from a fixed 4.43 kWh NMC lithium-ion battery.
TVS quotes up to 140 km under internal test conditions.
The 950 W onboard charger takes the battery from zero to 80 per cent in 3 hours 30 minutes and can use a household socket.

items.title: Tata Motors Leads India's Electric Car Market in October, Mahindra Ranks #2
points: Electric passenger vehicle registrations reached 36,064 units in October 2026, an increase of 76.7% from 20,411 in October 2025.
Tata Motors remained the largest electric car manufacturer, Mahindra strengthened its second place and MG slipped in market share despite selling more EVs than a year ago.
Tata registered 14,669 electric cars, up 77.6% year-on-year, for a 40.7% market share.
Even so, Tata's registrations were 6.5% lower than September's 15,691 units.
Unlike Tata, Mahindra also recorded a month-on-month improvement of 4.1%.
Together, Tata and Mahindra accounted for 64.4% of October electric car registrations.
Its October registrations were nevertheless 7.7% higher than September.
Maruti Suzuki ranked sixth with 1,200 registrations, broadly flat against September's 1,176, as its electric business develops around the e Vitara.

items.title: Super Micro stock soars: AI server boom drives record earnings
points: The stock gained 7.2% in after-hours trading, according to the report carried by KuCoin.
(Sources: Reuters, Quartz, KuCoin) Super Micro reported first-quarter fiscal 2027 revenue of $19.95 billion, compared with $5.02 billion a year earlier.
Revenue increased nearly fourfold year-on-year, comfortably beating analysts' average estimate of $16.39 billion.
Net income rose to $1.59 billion from $168 million in the year-ago quarter, while adjusted earnings reached $1.81 per share, beating the $1.23 analyst estimate.
Super Micro forecasts second-quarter revenue of $19.5 billion to $21.5 billion, exceeding Wall Street's estimate of $17.14 billion, according to Reuters.
The company expects adjusted earnings of $1.66 to $1.90 per share.
The revised forecast midpoint is also above Wall Street's estimate of $69.17 billion.
Super Micro's gross margin improved to 12.7% in the September quarter from 9.3% a year earlier.
